) { controlRetries.request() }
198: 
199:     fun connectControlSocket(rawServerUrl:String,cookie:String,ignoreSslCert:Boolean=false) {
200:         controlGeneration.locked {
201:             val url=OkHttpHelper.sanitizeServerUrl(rawServerUrl)
202:             val identity=Triple(url,cookie,ignoreSslCert)
203:             if(webSocket!=null && controlIdentity==identity && (controlConnecting || _connectionState.value)) return
204:             val epoch=controlGeneration.advance()
205:             cancelControlWork()
206:             controlTimeout?.cancel()
207:             controlTimeout=null
208:             stopPingLoop()
209:             stopNodePollLoop()
210:             val previous=webSocket
211:             webSocket=null
212:             previous?.cancel()
213:             if(controlIdentity!=identity) {
214:                 relayAuthCookie=""
215:                 userAuthCookie=""
216:                 _userInfo.value=null
217:                 meshesMap.clear()
218:                 nodesMap.clear()
219:                 _groupedDevices.value=emptyList()
220:             }
221:             controlIdentity=identity
222:             isUserLogout=false
223:             serverUrl=url
224:             authCookie=cookie
225:             ignoreSsl=ignoreSslCert
226:             _connectionState.value=false
227:             _connectionStatus.value=ConnectionStatus.CONNECTING
228:             controlConnecting=true
229:             controlConfigValid=true
230:             try {
231:                 val client=OkHttpHelper.createClient(ignoreSslCert)
232:                 okHttpClient=client
233:                 val request=Request.Builder().url(OkHttpHelper.toWebSocketUrl(url,"/control.ashx?moreargs=1"))
234:                     .apply { if(cookie.isNotBlank()) header("Cookie",cookie) }.build()
235:                 webSocket=client.newWebSocket(request,object:WebSocketListener() {
236:                     override fun onOpen(socket:WebSocket,response:Response) {
237:                         var accepted=false
238:                         controlGeneration.runIfCurrent(epoch) {
239:                             if(webSocket===socket && !isUserLogout) {
240:                                 accepted=true
241:                                 controlConnecting=false
242:                                 controlTimeout?.cancel()
243:                                 controlTimeout=null
244:                                 _connectionStatus.value=ConnectionStatus.CONNECTED
245:                                 _connectionState.value=true
246:                                 controlRetries.cancel()
247:                                 if(cookie.isNotBlank()) {
248:                                     val token=extractRawToken(cookie)
249:                                     val auth=JsonObject().apply {
250:                                         addProperty("action","urlargs")
251:                                         add("args",JsonObject().apply { addProperty("auth",token.ifEmpty { cookie }) })
252:                                     }
253:                                     socket.send(auth.toString())
254:                                 }
255:                                 launchControlWork { _ ->
256:                                     delay(150)
257:                                     requestServerData()
258:                                     delay(400)
259:                                     if(meshesMap.isEmpty() || nodesMap.isEmpty()) requestServerData()
260:                                 }
261:                                 startPingLoop()
262:                                 startNodePollLoop()
263:                             }
264:                         }
265:                         if(!accepted) socket.cancel()
266:                     }
267:                     override fun onMessage(socket:WebSocket,text:String) {
268:                         controlGeneration.runIfCurrent(epoch) {
269:                             if(webSocket===socket && !isUserLogout) handleControlMessage(text)
270:                         }
271:                     }
272:                     override fun onClosing(socket:WebSocket,code:Int,reason:String) {
273:                         retireControlSocket(epoch,socket)
274:                         socket.close(code,reason)
275:                     }
276:                     override fun onClosed(socket:WebSocket,code:Int,reason:String) {
277:                         retireC
